method: Built-in OpenAI image generation, using two botanical reference frames. Opaque two-part atlas: petal on the left, leaf on the right. Surface detail is also sampled for bump shading.

references.author: yellowcloud
references.title: Lithops flower bud growth and first bloom

changes: Generated continuous petal and leaf surface patches from reference frames. Source video frames are not distributed. This is a generated texture, not a photographic scan.
